分析流程与参数

从专题 README 抽取；原文顺序保留，未跑过的部分照实标注。

来源: 微信公众号原文：Nature Aging：学习Fig4c深刻理解空间邻域富集分析 ↗
蒸馏日期: 2026-11-01
类型: 微信公众号教程 + Squidpy 官方 API 交叉整理
分析范式: 10x Visium spot 级生态位（niche）/ 空间邻接图置换检验
可信度评级: 中 —— 方法链完整、本机可跑；但原文配图用到的 muscle-spatial.h5ad 未公开，本专题用合成双切片验证，且原文对 Nature Aging 作者代码的指控本库未独立核实（见第 8 节）
图册位置: 06_空转/01_Visium/1.3_空间邻域富集分析，预览源为 results/fig_pooled_vs_per_library.pdf

2. 分析流程 🔶

流程图源码（Mermaid）
flowchart LR
    A[Visium h5ad<br/>obsm['spatial'] + niche 标签 + 切片 ID] --> B[清理重复 obs 列<br/>标签转 categorical 固定顺序]
    B --> C{多样本?}
    C -->|是| D["spatial_neighbors(library_key='sample_id')<br/>每个切片独立建图，块对角拼接"]
    C -->|否| E["spatial_neighbors()<br/>单张图"]
    D --> F[断言：跨切片边 = 0]
    E --> F
    F --> G["nhood_enrichment(n_perms=1000, seed)<br/>切片内置换标签"]
    G --> H[z-score 矩阵 + 观测邻接计数]
    H --> I[Fig4c 式热图 PDF<br/>RdBu_r / 对称色标 / 数值标注]
    H --> J[长表 + 分切片矩阵<br/>检查是否单切片驱动]
详细步骤
步骤 输入 工具 输出 状态
1. 读入 .h5ad（obsm['spatial']） scanpy.read_h5ad AnnData ✅
2. 清理 obs AnnData drop_duplicate_obs_columns 无重复列名的 obs ✅
3. 固定标签顺序 obs 列 pd.Categorical(categories=...) 行列顺序可复现 ✅
4. 建空间图 坐标 + library_key sq.gr.spatial_neighbors obsp['spatial_connectivities'] ✅
5. 图诊断 邻接矩阵 自写 graph_summary 度数分布 + 跨切片边数 ✅
6. 置换检验 图 + 标签 sq.gr.nhood_enrichment z-score、count ✅
7. 出图 z-score 矩阵 matplotlib PDF 热图 ✅
8. 自检 z-score 矩阵 03_selfcheck.py PASS/FAIL ✅

5. 关键参数 🔶

参数 本专题默认 说明
library_key sample_id 最关键参数。多样本必须传，否则跨切片 spot 互为邻居
coord_type grid Visium 六边形网格；Xenium/CosMx/MERFISH 用 generic
n_neighs 6 Visium 每个 spot 有 6 个六边形邻居
n_rings 1 1 环即直接相邻；2 环会和「隔一个 spot」混在一起
n_perms 1000 置换次数；z-score 的标准误 ≈ 1/sqrt(n_perms)
seed 42 固定后 z-score 可逐位复现
niche_order 5 个 Niche 决定热图行列顺序，必须显式固定
annotate true 热图标注数值；5 × 5 时可以标，20 × 20 建议关掉

⚠️ spatial_neighbors 和 nhood_enrichment 的 library_key 必须一致。
只传给前者 = 「图对了但零分布错了」，本机实测仍能造成最大 15.4 的 z-score 偏移（见第 7 节 panel C）。

8. 注意事项 🔶

8.1 多样本直接建图 = 结论不可用（本专题存在的理由）

原文作者核对 Nature Aging 论文代码后指出：作者把多张切片合并后只建了一张空间邻接图。
不同切片不是同一张组织地图，跨切片的 spot 不可能是物理邻居。Squidpy 提供 library_key
就是为了让每个 library 独立建图。

诚信边界：这条指控来自公众号作者，本库没有独立重跑原文代码，也没有拿到 muscle-spatial.h5ad。
本专题做的是把「为什么会错、错了差多少」变成可复现实验，而不是替原文下结论。

本机合成数据上的量化（同一份数据、同一套标签，只改建图方式）：

建图方式 跨切片边 平均度 max|Δz| 平均|Δz| Pearson r 符号翻转（20 个非对角配对）
按切片 + 切片内置换（正确） 0 5.858 — — — —
合并建图 + 全局置换（原文做法） 8,754 5.914 35.6 11.8 0.964 4
按切片建图 + 全局置换（半修） 0 5.858 15.4 3.0 0.995 2

8,754 条跨切片边占全部 31,200 条边的 28%——接近三成的「邻居」在物理上不存在。
即便只是忘了给 nhood_enrichment 传 library_key（图是对的，零分布错了），
z-score 仍会偏移到 15.4 并翻转 2 个配对符号。

8.2 其他坑
  • 对角线压色标：对角线 z 常在 100 量级，非对角线只有个位数。用全矩阵定色标会让所有有意义配对变白，本模板默认按非对角线定色标并在图注说明。
  • set_diag 默认 False：邻接矩阵不含自环，nhood_enrichment 的观测计数也不含自己；不要手动加自环。
  • 置换的是标签，不是坐标：nhood_enrichment 在固定图上打乱 niche 标签，零假设是「标签在切片内随机分布」。所以 z 的绝对值随 niche 的空间成团程度变化，不能跨数据集比较大小。
  • 切片边缘 spot 度数低：真实 Visium 整张切片 4,039 spots 实测 median degree = 6、mean = 5.82、1 个孤立 spot（组织边缘）；子采样到 1,000 spots 后 mean 掉到 4.07、8 个孤立 spot。不要对子采样数据解读绝对度数。
  • h5ad 重复 obs 列：round-trip 后可能出现同名列，adata.obs[key] 会返回 DataFrame 而不是 Series，直接让下游报错；模板里第一步就清掉。
  • 坐标单位：Visium 相邻 spot 中心距 100 µm，行距 ≈86.6 µm；array_row/array_col 是网格索引，不是 µm，不要拿去做距离。
  • Xenium/CosMx 不适用 coord_type='grid'：单细胞分割平台用 generic + kNN 或 Delaunay，且不需要去卷积。

真实 Visium 坐标验证（不进 results/，仅作几何口径核对）：
取 1.2_Cell2location反卷积 的 V1_Human_Lymph_Node 全切片 4,039 spots（tissue_positions_list.csv），

复现边界：

  1. 演示数据是合成的，验证的是代码正确性与方法差异，不是生物学结论。
  2. 原文的 muscle-spatial.h5ad 未公开，本库没有复现 Fig. 4c 本身。
  3. 原文对 Nature Aging 作者建图方式的批评，本库未独立核实，只把它当作动机，用可复现实验说明「这样建图会差多少」。
  4. 真实数据只做了几何口径核对（度数分布），没有做多样本真实数据的完整复现。
展开其余 7 个章节（工具栈、数据格式、可视化方法、参考文献等）

1. 生物学问题 ✅

把 Visium spot 按转录组聚成若干「组织生态位（niche）」后，问一个纯空间的问题：两类 niche 是不是比随机预期更常挨在一起？

  • 疾病/系统: 包涵体肌炎（inclusion body myositis, IBM）vs 其他炎性肌病
  • 组织: 人骨骼肌活检
  • 原文数据: snRNA-seq + Visium + IHC/smFISH 三层证据
  • 原文五类 niche: Niche 0 稳态肌纤维区；Niche 1 损伤/反应性肌纤维；Niche 2 结缔组织/纤维化（FAP）；Niche 3 炎症（T/B/cDC1/促炎 MΦ/EC-V）；Niche 4 血管及血管周围重塑（MΦ2/LAMP3⁺ DC/EC-A/COL15A1⁺ FAP）
  • 原文结论: IBM 从「肌纤维稳态生态位」转向「炎症—血管—损伤生态位」，炎症空间环境与 II 型肌纤维信号缺失重叠
  • 本方法能回答: 某两类 niche 的空间邻接是否偏离随机
  • 本方法不能回答: 因果、方向性、细胞间通讯分子机制、组间差异是否显著

演示数据是合成的（scripts/00_make_demo_data.py，固定 seed=42），

6. 代码片段

完整可运行代码在 scripts/，参数全部走 config.example.yaml：

  • scripts/nhood_core.py —— 可复用函数库（建图 / 置换 / 出图 / 漂移比较），别的项目直接 import
  • scripts/00_make_demo_data.py —— 生成双切片演示数据
  • scripts/01_nhood_enrichment.py —— 主入口：按切片建图 + 富集 + 出图（--per-section 出分切片矩阵）
  • scripts/02_pooled_vs_per_library.py —— 合并建图 vs 按切片建图的量化对照
  • scripts/03_selfcheck.py —— 对照植入结构自检
6.1 最小可用调用（复制这 4 行）
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import nhood_core as core, scanpy as sc

adata = sc.read_h5ad("your_data.h5ad")
core.prepare_labels(adata, cluster_key="niche", library_key="sample_id")
core.build_graph(adata, library_key="sample_id", coord_type="grid", n_neighs=6)
zscore, count, labels = core.enrich(adata, "niche", library_key="sample_id",
                                    n_perms=1000, seed=42)
6.2 多样本建图（本专题的核心一行）
# library_key 让每个 sample_id 各自建图，再块对角拼接：
# 不同切片的坐标即使重合，也不会被连成邻居
sq.gr.spatial_neighbors(work, spatial_key="spatial", library_key="sample_id")
6.3 断言「没有跨切片边」
conn = adata.obsp["spatial_connectivities"].tocoo()
lib = adata.obs["sample_id"].astype(str).to_numpy()
n_cross = int((lib[conn.row] != lib[conn.col]).sum())
assert n_cross == 0, f"跨切片边 {n_cross} 条，library_key 没生效"

7. 可视化方法 ✅

图表 工具 数据 本机输出
邻域富集热图（Fig4c 式） matplotlib imshow + RdBu_r z-score 矩阵 results/fig_nhood_heatmap.pdf
niche 空间分布 matplotlib scatter 小多图 obsm['spatial'] + 标签 results/fig_nhood_domains.pdf
分切片热图 matplotlib 子图 nhood_zscore_by_section.tsv results/fig_nhood_heatmap_by_section.pdf
合并 vs 按切片 4 联图 matplotlib 2 × 2 三种建图方式 results/fig_pooled_vs_per_library.pdf

读图口径：

  • 正 z（红）：这两类 niche 相邻次数高于置换预期 → 倾向空间邻近
  • 负 z（蓝）：相邻次数低于预期 → 倾向空间分隔
  • 对角线：同一类 niche 是否倾向和自己相邻（成团程度）
  • 色标：RdBu_r，以 0 为白、上下对称；本专题默认用非对角线范围定色标，否则对角线会把所有有意义的配对压成白色（数值仍印在格子里）

本机实测（合成双切片，1000 次置换，seed=42）：对角线 45–118，非对角线 −49 到 +8.5。
其中 Niche 0 × Niche 3 = +8.55（patchwork 交错）、Niche 1 × Niche 0 = −28.89（粗分区只有边界接触），
与植入结构一致。

10. 适用场景

  • 数据兼容: 任何带 obsm['spatial'] 的 AnnData —— Visium、Visium HD、Stereo-seq bin、Xenium、CosMx、MERFISH、Slide-seq
  • 规模: 单切片 1k–10k spot 秒级；多样本按切片数线性增长（本机 5,276 spots × 2 切片 × 1,000 置换 ≈ 33 s / 4 workers）
  • 前提: 已有 niche / 细胞类型标签；标签是输入，不是本专题的产物
  • 不适用: 单细胞分割平台（Xenium 等）做「去卷积」；没有空间坐标的数据；想推断因果或通讯分子机制
  • 可迁移性: 换数据集只需改 config.example.yaml 的 input / columns / graph；coord_type 是唯一需要按平台改的结构参数

分析代码

7 个源码文件，按目录顺序；本机绝对路径已替换为 ~。 代码可复制，但需要按自己的数据改路径与参数。

config.example.yaml yaml · 2226 bytes 
# Spatial neighborhood enrichment — example profile.
#
# The default run is fully self-contained: it generates a two-section
# Visium-like demo (data/demo_two_sections.h5ad), so nothing has to be
# downloaded. Point `input` at your own h5ad to switch to real data — only
# obsm['spatial'], a niche/cluster column and a section column are required.
seed: 42

demo:
  output: data/demo_two_sections.h5ad
  n_rows: 64
  n_cols: 64
  tissue_radius: 2700        # keep spots inside a circular tissue footprint
  n_genes: 600
  markers_per_niche: 40
  signal: 8.0                # Poisson mean inside a niche's marker block
  background: 0.6            # Poisson mean elsewhere
  layout:
    left_fraction: 0.28      # coarse territory on the left
    right_fraction: 0.72     # coarse territory on the right
    patch_block: 250         # um; checkerboard period of the patchwork zone
    vessel_width: 120        # um; vessel-like stripe width
    vessel_centres: [0.40, 0.60]
  sections:
    # Same geometry, different niche identities: the two sections cannot be
    # pooled into one graph without inventing adjacencies.
    - name: Section_A
      scale: 1.0
      offset: [0, 0]
      roles:
        territory_left: "Niche 1"
        patch_a: "Niche 0"
        patch_b: "Niche 3"
        vessel: "Niche 4"
        territory_right: "Niche 2"
    - name: Section_B
      scale: 1.0
      offset: [1700, 900]    # each section is registered to its own image
      roles:
        territory_left: "Niche 3"
        patch_a: "Niche 1"
        patch_b: "Niche 4"
        vessel: "Niche 0"
        territory_right: "Niche 2"

input: data/demo_two_sections.h5ad
results_dir: results

columns:
  cluster_key: niche        # 生态位 / 细胞类型 / 聚类标签
  library_key: sample_id    # 切片 ID；单切片数据可留空字符串 ""
  spatial_key: spatial

graph:
  coord_type: grid          # grid = Visium 六边形；generic = Xenium/CosMx kNN
  n_neighs: 6               # Visium 每个 spot 有 6 个六边形邻居
  n_rings: 1
  delaunay: false

enrichment:
  n_perms: 1000
  n_jobs: 4

niche_order: ["Niche 0", "Niche 1", "Niche 2", "Niche 3", "Niche 4"]

plots:
  point_size: 6
  annotate: true
  palette: tab10
run_smoke_test.sh bash · 1077 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# End-to-end smoke test for the spatial neighborhood enrichment template.
#
#   bash run_smoke_test.sh
#
# Runs on the synthetic two-section demo (~9k spots, 5 niches) so no download
# is required. Total runtime on this machine: about 2 minutes, 4 CPU workers.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PYTHON_BIN="${PYTHON_BIN:-~/miniforge3/envs/st_env5/bin/python}"
export MPLBACKEND=Agg

cd "${ROOT}"
mkdir -p results logs

echo "== 00 生成双切片演示数据 =="

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a two-section Visium-like demo dataset with a *planted* niche layout.

Why synthetic: the Nature Aging muscle h5ad used by the source article is not
public, and every public Visium download is hundreds of MB. A planted layout
is better for teaching anyway — we know which niches are supposed to touch, so
the enrichment matrix can be checked against ground truth instead of against a
figure in a paper.

Layout of one section (x runs left to right over the tissue footprint):

    x < 28%            -> territory_left      (coarse, contiguous)
    x > 72%            -> territory_right     (coarse, contiguous)
    28% <= x <= 72%    -> two-colour patchwork of `patch_a` / `patch_b`
                          on a ~250 um checkerboard (fine-grained interleaving)
    two 120 um bands   -> `vessel`, a vessel-like stripe crossing the patchwork

The patchwork is the key part: `patch_a` and `patch_b` are interleaved at the
2-3 spot scale, so they are genuinely each other's neighbours far more often
than chance (positive z), while the two coarse territories sit apart (negative
z). A ring/territory-only layout cannot produce that — every off-diagonal
would come out negative simply because coarse blocks only meet at boundaries.

Section A and Section B use the same geometry but *swap which niche name plays
which role*. That is what makes the multi-section trap visible: pooling the
sections connects a Section A spot to a Section B spot that happens to sit at
the same coordinates, and those two spots belong to different niches by
construction — the pooled matrix reports adjacencies that exist in neither
section.

Usage:
    python scripts/00_make_demo_data.py --config config.example.yaml
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
from scipy import sparse

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NICHES = ["Niche 0", "Niche 1", "Niche 2", "Niche 3", "Niche 4"]

# Visium geometry: neighbouring spot centres are 100 um apart, rows are offset
# by half a spot and spaced 100 * sqrt(3)/2 ~= 86.6 um.
SPOT_PITCH = 100.0
ROW_PITCH = 100.0 * np.sqrt(3) / 2


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def build_hex_grid(n_rows: int, n_cols: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return (array_row, array_col, pixel xy) for a Visium-like hex lattice."""
    rows, cols = np.meshgrid(np.arange(n_rows), np.arange(n_cols), indexing="ij")
    rows = rows.ravel()
    cols = cols.ravel()
    xy = np.column_stack([
        cols * SPOT_PITCH + (rows % 2) * SPOT_PITCH / 2,
        rows * ROW_PITCH,
    ])
    return rows, cols, xy


def assign_mosaic(xy: np.ndarray, roles: dict, layout: dict) -> np.ndarray:
    """Assign a niche to every spot from the mosaic layout described above."""
    role = roles
    x = xy[:, 0] - xy[:, 0].min()
    y = xy[:, 1] - xy[:, 1].min()
    width = x.max()

    labels = np.empty(xy.shape[0], dtype=object)
    labels[:] = role["patch_a"]

    patch = (x >= layout["left_fraction"] * width) & (x <= layout["right_fraction"] * width)
    block = (
        np.floor(x / layout["patch_block"]) + np.floor(y / layout["patch_block"])
    ).astype(int) % 2
    # checkerboard inside the patchwork zone
    labels[patch & (block == 1)] = role["patch_b"]
    labels[patch & (block == 0)] = role["patch_a"]

    # coarse territories overwrite the two sides
    labels[x < layout["left_fraction"] * width] = role["territory_left"]
    labels[x > layout["right_fraction"] * width] = role["territory_right"]

    # vessel-like stripes overwrite everything, so they contact both patch types
    for centre in layout["vessel_centres"]:
        centre_x = centre * width
        band = (x >= centre_x) & (x < centre_x + layout["vessel_width"])
        labels[band] = role["vessel"]

    return labels


def simulate_counts(
    labels: np.ndarray,
    n_genes: int,
    markers_per_niche: int,
    signal: float,
    background: float,
    rng: np.random.Generator,
) -> sparse.csr_matrix:
    """Poisson counts: each niche lifts its own marker block above background."""
    means = np.full((labels.shape[0], n_genes), background, dtype=float)
    role_order = list(dict.fromkeys(labels))
    for position, niche in enumerate(role_order):
        start = position * markers_per_niche
        stop = start + markers_per_niche
        rows = np.where(labels == niche)[0]
        means[np.ix_(rows, np.arange(start, stop))] = signal
    counts = rng.poisson(means).astype(np.float32)
    return sparse.csr_matrix(counts)


def make_section(cfg: dict, spec: dict, rng: np.random.Generator) -> ad.AnnData:
    rows, cols, xy = build_hex_grid(cfg["demo"]["n_rows"], cfg["demo"]["n_cols"])
    centre = xy.mean(axis=0)
    radius = np.hypot(*(xy - centre).T)
    keep = radius < cfg["demo"]["tissue_radius"]
    rows, cols, xy = rows[keep], cols[keep], xy[keep]

    labels = assign_mosaic(xy, spec["roles"], cfg["demo"]["layout"])
    counts = simulate_counts(
        labels,
        n_genes=cfg["demo"]["n_genes"],
        markers_per_niche=cfg["demo"]["markers_per_niche"],
        signal=cfg["demo"]["signal"],
        background=cfg["demo"]["background"],
        rng=rng,
    )
    adata = ad.AnnData(X=counts)
    adata.obs_names = [f"{spec['name']}-{i:05d}" for i in range(adata.n_obs)]
    adata.var_names = [f"GENE{i:04d}" for i in range(adata.n_vars)]
    adata.obs["sample_id"] = spec["name"]
    adata.obs["niche"] = pd.Categorical(labels, categories=NICHES)
    adata.obs["array_row"] = rows.astype(int)
    adata.obs["array_col"] = cols.astype(int)
    adata.obs["in_tissue"] = 1

    # Pixel coordinates as they would come out of Space Ranger after image
    # alignment: each section is registered to its own image, so its frame
    # starts near the origin again. An explicit offset keeps the two frames
    # only partially overlapping — the realistic case, and still enough to
    # fabricate cross-section neighbours.
    offset = np.asarray(spec.get("offset", [0.0, 0.0]), dtype=float)
    adata.obsm["spatial"] = xy.astype(float) * spec["scale"] + offset
    return adata


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="config.example.yaml", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--out", default=None, type=Path,
                        help="覆盖 config 里的 demo.output")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(resolve(args.config))
    out = resolve(args.out or cfg["demo"]["output"])
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(cfg["seed"])
    sections = [make_section(cfg, spec, rng) for spec in cfg["demo"]["sections"]]
    adata = ad.concat(sections, index_unique=None)
    adata.obs["sample_id"] = pd.Categorical(adata.obs["sample_id"])
    adata.obs["niche"] = pd.Categorical(adata.obs["niche"], categories=NICHES, ordered=True)
    adata.uns["demo_truth"] = {
        "layout": json.dumps(cfg["demo"]["layout"], ensure_ascii=False),
        "sections": json.dumps(cfg["demo"]["sections"], ensure_ascii=False),
        "expected": (
            "patch_a 与 patch_b 细粒度交错 -> 正 z；"
            "territory_left/right 与 patchwork 只有边界接触 -> 负 z；"
            "vessel 贯穿 patchwork -> 与两种 patch 均为正 z"
        ),
    }
    adata.write_h5ad(out)

    print(f"写入 {out}")
    print(f"  维度: {adata.shape[0]} spots x {adata.shape[1]} genes")
    print("  每切片 spot 数:")
    print(adata.obs["sample_id"].value_counts().sort_index().to_string())
    print("  每切片 niche 组成:")
    print(pd.crosstab(adata.obs["sample_id"], adata.obs["niche"]).to_string())
    coords = pd.DataFrame(adata.obsm["spatial"], columns=["x", "y"])
    coords["sample_id"] = adata.obs["sample_id"].to_numpy()
    print("  各切片坐标范围（部分重叠即建图陷阱的来源）:")
    print(coords.groupby("sample_id", observed=True).agg(["min", "max"]).to_string())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Spatial neighborhood enrichment, one graph per library.

This is the reusable entry point: point it at any h5ad that carries
``obsm['spatial']`` plus a label column, and it writes

    results/nhood_zscore.tsv          z-score matrix (row/col = niche)
    results/nhood_count.tsv           observed neighbour-pair counts
    results/nhood_pairs.tsv           long table, sorted by z-score
    results/fig_nhood_heatmap.pdf     the Fig. 4c-style matrix
    results/fig_nhood_domains.pdf     spot map of the niches per section
    results/nhood_graph_summary.tsv   graph diagnostics (incl. cross-library edges)

and, with ``--per-section``, a per-section matrix plus a facet heatmap so you
can see whether one section drives the pooled signal.

The one hard assertion: after building the graph, the number of adjacency
edges that cross library boundaries must be 0. If it is not, the enrichment is
not a statement about any real tissue section.

Usage:
    python scripts/01_nhood_enrichment.py --config config.example.yaml
    python scripts/01_nhood_enrichment.py --config my.yaml --per-section
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import anndata as ad
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import yaml

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import nhood_core as core  # noqa: E402


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def pairs_table(matrix: np.ndarray, labels: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for i, row_label in enumerate(labels):
        for j, col_label in enumerate(labels):
            rows.append({
                "niche_row": row_label,
                "niche_col": col_label,
                "zscore": float(matrix[i, j]),
                "is_diagonal": i == j,
            })
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    return frame.sort_values("zscore", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)


def enrich_one(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    cluster_key: str,
    library_key: str | None,
    cfg: dict,
    tag: str,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, list[str], dict]:
    graph = cfg["graph"]
    core.build_graph(
        adata,
        library_key=library_key,
        coord_type=graph["coord_type"],
        n_neighs=graph["n_neighs"],
        n_rings=graph["n_rings"],
        delaunay=graph["delaunay"],
        spatial_key=cfg["columns"]["spatial_key"],
    )
    stats = core.graph_summary(adata, library_key)
    if library_key is not None and stats["cross_library_edges"] != 0:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"[{tag}] 跨切片边 = {stats['cross_library_edges']}，"
            "library_key 没有生效；请检查 obs 列是否为分类变量"
        )

    zscore, count, labels = core.enrich(
        adata,
        cluster_key=cluster_key,
        library_key=library_key,
        n_perms=cfg["enrichment"]["n_perms"],
        seed=cfg["seed"],
        n_jobs=cfg["enrichment"]["n_jobs"],
    )
    stats.update({"tag": tag, "cluster_key": cluster_key,
                  "library_key": library_key or "", "n_niches": len(labels)})
    return zscore, count, labels, stats


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="config.example.yaml", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--input", default=None, type=Path,
                        help="覆盖 config 的 input")
    parser.add_argument("--per-section", action="store_true",
                        help="额外为每个切片单独计算一张矩阵")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(resolve(args.config))
    out_dir = resolve(cfg["results_dir"])
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    input_path = resolve(args.input or cfg["input"])
    adata = sc.read_h5ad(input_path)
    dropped = core.drop_duplicate_obs_columns(adata)
    if dropped:
        print(f"移除重复 obs 列: {dropped}")

    cluster_key = cfg["columns"]["cluster_key"]
    library_key = cfg["columns"]["library_key"] or None
    niche_order = cfg.get("niche_order") or None
    core.prepare_labels(adata, cluster_key, library_key, niche_order)
    core.assert_spatial(adata, cfg["columns"]["spatial_key"])
    print(f"输入 {input_path} -> {adata.n_obs} spots x {adata.n_vars} genes, "
          f"{adata.obs[cluster_key].nunique()} niches, "
          f"{adata.obs[library_key].nunique() if library_key else 1} libraries")

    zscore, count, labels, stats = enrich_one(adata, cluster_key, library_key, cfg, "per_library")
    core.write_matrix(zscore, labels, out_dir / "nhood_zscore.tsv")
    core.write_matrix(count, labels, out_dir / "nhood_count.tsv")
    pairs_table(zscore, labels).to_csv(out_dir / "nhood_pairs.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
    pd.DataFrame([stats]).to_csv(out_dir / "nhood_graph_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.6, 5.0))
    ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
    core.plot_heatmap(
        zscore, labels, ax=ax,
        title=f"Neighborhood enrichment\n(library_key = {library_key or 'none'})",
        annotate=cfg["plots"]["annotate"],
        fontsize=8,
    )
    core.save_pdf(fig, out_dir / "fig_nhood_heatmap.pdf")

    domains = core.plot_domains(
        adata, cluster_key, library_key,
        spatial_key=cfg["columns"]["spatial_key"],
        title="Spatial niches per section",
        point_size=cfg["plots"]["point_size"],
        palette=cfg["plots"]["palette"],
    )
    core.save_pdf(domains, out_dir / "fig_nhood_domains.pdf")

    print("\n最强的正/负邻接（z-score）:")
    print(pairs_table(zscore, labels).head(5).to_string(index=False))
    print("...")
    print(pairs_table(zscore, labels).tail(5).to_string(index=False))

    if args.per_section and library_key is not None:
        rows = []
        panel = []
        for lib in adata.obs[library_key].cat.categories:
            sub = adata[adata.obs[library_key] == lib].copy()
            sub.obs[library_key] = sub.obs[library_key].astype(str)
            sub.obs[cluster_key] = pd.Categorical(
                sub.obs[cluster_key].astype(str), categories=labels, ordered=True
            )
            z_lib, _, _, _ = enrich_one(sub, cluster_key, None, cfg, f"section:{lib}")
            panel.append((str(lib), z_lib))
            frame = pd.DataFrame(z_lib, index=labels, columns=labels)
            frame.insert(0, "section", str(lib))
            frame.index.name = "niche_row"
            rows.append(frame.reset_index())

        per_section = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
        per_section.to_csv(out_dir / "nhood_zscore_by_section.tsv", sep="\t",
                           float_format="%.4f", index=False)

        limit = core.symmetric_limit(np.vstack([m for _, m in panel]))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(panel), figsize=(5.6 * len(panel), 5.0),
                                 squeeze=False)
        for i, (ax, (name, matrix)) in enumerate(zip(axes[0], panel)):
            core.plot_heatmap(matrix, labels, ax=ax, title=f"{name} only",
                              annotate=cfg["plots"]["annotate"], limit=limit, fontsize=7,
                              show_cbar=(i == len(panel) - 1),
                              cbar_label="Spatial proximity (z-score)")
        fig.suptitle("Per-section enrichment (same niche order, shared colour scale)",
                     fontsize=10)
        fig.tight_layout(w_pad=3.0)
        core.save_pdf(fig, out_dir / "fig_nhood_heatmap_by_section.pdf")

    print(f"\n结果目录: {out_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
scripts/02_pooled_vs_per_library.py python · 6588 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""What happens if the sections share one spatial graph: quantified.

Three variants over the *same* data and the *same* labels:

    per_library     graph per section + labels permuted within section   (correct)
    pooled          one graph over all sections + global permutation     (the bug)
    hybrid          graph per section, but labels permuted globally      (half-fixed)

``pooled`` is what you get from ``sq.gr.spatial_neighbors(adata)`` followed by
``sq.gr.nhood_enrichment(adata, cluster_key=...)`` on a multi-section AnnData —
the two calls that a single-section tutorial teaches. Sections are separate
pieces of tissue; their coordinates live in separate image frames, so any spot
pair across sections is a fabricated neighbour.

Outputs
    results/fig_pooled_vs_per_library.pdf   three heatmaps + difference map
    results/pooled_vs_per_library.tsv       per-pair z-scores in all variants
    results/pooled_vs_per_library_summary.tsv  drift statistics + graph stats

Usage:
    python scripts/02_pooled_vs_per_library.py --config config.example.yaml
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import yaml

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import nhood_core as core  # noqa: E402


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def run_variant(adata, cfg, library_key_graph, library_key_perms, tag):
    work = adata.copy()
    graph = cfg["graph"]
    core.build_graph(
        work,
        library_key=library_key_graph,
        coord_type=graph["coord_type"],
        n_neighs=graph["n_neighs"],
        n_rings=graph["n_rings"],
        delaunay=graph["delaunay"],
        spatial_key=cfg["columns"]["spatial_key"],
    )
    stats = core.graph_summary(work, cfg["columns"]["library_key"] or None)
    zscore, _, labels = core.enrich(
        work,
        cluster_key=cfg["columns"]["cluster_key"],
        library_key=library_key_perms,
        n_perms=cfg["enrichment"]["n_perms"],
        seed=cfg["seed"],
        n_jobs=cfg["enrichment"]["n_jobs"],
    )
    stats.update({"variant": tag})
    return zscore, labels, stats


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="config.example.yaml", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--input", default=None, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(resolve(args.config))
    out_dir = resolve(cfg["results_dir"])
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    input_path = resolve(args.input or cfg["input"])
    adata = sc.read_h5ad(input_path)
    core.drop_duplicate_obs_columns(adata)
    cluster_key = cfg["columns"]["cluster_key"]
    library_key = cfg["columns"]["library_key"] or None
    if library_key is None:
        raise SystemExit("本脚本需要 columns.library_key（多样本对照才有意义）")
    core.prepare_labels(adata, cluster_key, library_key, cfg.get("niche_order"))
    core.assert_spatial(adata, cfg["columns"]["spatial_key"])
    print(f"输入 {input_path}: {adata.n_obs} spots, "
          f"{adata.obs[library_key].nunique()} libraries")

    results = {}
    stats_rows = []
    for tag, graph_key, perm_key in [
        ("per_library", library_key, library_key),
        ("pooled", None, None),
        ("hybrid", library_key, None),
    ]:
        zscore, labels, stats = run_variant(adata, cfg, graph_key, perm_key, tag)
        results[tag] = zscore
        stats_rows.append(stats)
        print(f"[{tag}] 跨切片边={stats['cross_library_edges']}, "
              f"平均度={stats['mean_degree']}")

    reference = results["per_library"]
    drift = {
        tag: core.compare_matrices(reference, matrix, labels)
        for tag, matrix in results.items() if tag != "per_library"
    }
    summary = pd.DataFrame(stats_rows)
    for tag, values in drift.items():
        for key, value in values.items():
            summary.loc[summary["variant"] == tag, key] = value
    summary.to_csv(out_dir / "pooled_vs_per_library_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

    long_rows = []
    for tag, matrix in results.items():
        frame = pd.DataFrame(matrix, index=labels, columns=labels)
        for i, row_label in enumerate(labels):
            for j, col_label in enumerate(labels):
                long_rows.append({
                    "variant": tag, "niche_row": row_label, "niche_col": col_label,
                    "zscore": float(frame.iloc[i, j]),
                })
    pd.DataFrame(long_rows).to_csv(
        out_dir / "pooled_vs_per_library.tsv", sep="\t", index=False, float_format="%.4f"
    )

    # ---- figure: three matrices on a shared scale + the drift map ----
    # The shared scale must come from the *off-diagonal* of each matrix: the
    # diagonal is an order of magnitude larger and would wash out every pair.
    limit = max(core.symmetric_limit(matrix) for matrix in
                (reference, results["pooled"], results["hybrid"]))
    drift_limit = core.symmetric_limit(results["pooled"] - reference, step=2.0,
                                       exclude_diagonal=False)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11.0, 9.6))
    panels = [
        (axes[0, 0], reference, "A. per-library graph (correct)", limit),
        (axes[0, 1], results["pooled"], "B. pooled graph (the multi-section bug)", limit),
        (axes[1, 0], results["hybrid"], "C. per-library graph, global permutation", limit),
        (axes[1, 1], results["pooled"] - reference, "D. B - A (drift)", drift_limit),
    ]
    for ax, matrix, title, panel_limit in panels:
        core.plot_heatmap(matrix, labels, ax=ax, title=title, annotate=True,
                          limit=panel_limit, fontsize=7)
    fig.suptitle(
        "Same data, same labels, three ways of building the neighbourhood graph\n"
        f"colour scale fixed on the off-diagonal range (+/-{limit:.0f}); "
        "diagonal cells saturate",
        fontsize=10,
    )
    fig.tight_layout()
    core.save_pdf(fig, out_dir / "fig_pooled_vs_per_library.pdf")

    print("\n漂移统计（相对 per_library）:")
    print(pd.DataFrame(drift).T.to_string())
    print(f"\n结果目录: {out_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the demo run against the planted layout (a regression test, not biology).

The demo generator plants a known adjacency structure, so the enrichment matrix
has a right answer. This script asserts it, which is what makes the template
"verified locally" rather than "ran without crashing".

Checks (all on the per-library matrix):
  1. patch_a x patch_b  > 0   -- interleaved patchwork must read as adjacent
  2. vessel x patch_a   > 0   -- the stripe crosses the patchwork
  3. territory_left x patch_a < 0 -- coarse territories only meet at boundaries
  4. the matrix is symmetric (permutation test is undirected)
  5. no NaN in the matrix

Usage:
    python scripts/03_selfcheck.py --config config.example.yaml
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def load_config(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return yaml.safe_load(handle)


def resolve(value: str | Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(value)
    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="config.example.yaml", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(resolve(args.config))
    results = resolve(cfg["results_dir"])
    zscore = pd.read_csv(results / "nhood_zscore.tsv", sep="\t", index_col=0)
    roles = cfg["demo"]["sections"][0]["roles"]

    checks: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []

    def pair(a: str, b: str) -> float:
        return float(zscore.loc[a, b])

    checks.append((
        "patch_a x patch_b > 0",
        pair(roles["patch_a"], roles["patch_b"]) > 0,
        f"{roles['patch_a']} x {roles['patch_b']} = "
        f"{pair(roles['patch_a'], roles['patch_b']):.2f}",
    ))
    checks.append((
        "vessel x patch_a > 0",
        pair(roles["vessel"], roles["patch_a"]) > 0,
        f"{roles['vessel']} x {roles['patch_a']} = "
        f"{pair(roles['vessel'], roles['patch_a']):.2f}",
    ))
    checks.append((
        "territory_left x patch_a < 0",
        pair(roles["territory_left"], roles["patch_a"]) < 0,
        f"{roles['territory_left']} x {roles['patch_a']} = "
        f"{pair(roles['territory_left'], roles['patch_a']):.2f}",
    ))
    symmetric = np.allclose(zscore.to_numpy(), zscore.to_numpy().T, atol=1e-6)
    checks.append(("matrix symmetric", symmetric, f"max|M-M.T| = "
                   f"{np.abs(zscore.to_numpy() - zscore.to_numpy().T).max():.2e}"))
    no_nan = not zscore.isna().any().any()
    checks.append(("no NaN", no_nan, f"NaN count = {int(zscore.isna().sum().sum())}"))

    failed = 0
    print(f"自检 {results / 'nhood_zscore.tsv'}")
    for name, ok, detail in checks:
        print(f"  [{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {name}: {detail}")
        failed += 0 if ok else 1
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"{failed} 项自检失败")

    print("\n全部自检通过。注意：这些是预先植入的合成结构，不是生物学结论。")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reusable helpers for spatial neighborhood enrichment (Squidpy / AnnData).

The one rule this module exists to enforce: **build the spatial graph per
library**. Spots from two Visium sections are never each other's physical
neighbours, no matter how similar their pixel coordinates look. Passing
``library_key`` to ``spatial_neighbors`` produces a block-diagonal adjacency
matrix (one block per section); leaving it out silently connects sections.

Every public function takes a plain AnnData, so the same code works for
Visium, Stereo-seq bins or Xenium cells — only ``coord_type`` changes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable, Sequence

import anndata as ad
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import squidpy as sq
from scipy import sparse

# Keep text editable in the exported PDF (TrueType, not outlines).
mpl.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42
mpl.rcParams["ps.fonttype"] = 42


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# input preparation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def drop_duplicate_obs_columns(adata: ad.AnnData) -> list[str]:
    """Drop duplicated ``obs`` column names (h5ad round-trips can create them).

    Duplicated columns survive an h5ad write and then make ``adata.obs[key]``
    return a DataFrame instead of a Series, which breaks downstream code.
    """
    duplicated = adata.obs.columns[adata.obs.columns.duplicated()].tolist()
    if duplicated:
        adata.obs = adata.obs.loc[:, ~adata.obs.columns.duplicated()].copy()
    return duplicated


def prepare_labels(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    cluster_key: str,
    library_key: str | None,
    cluster_order: Sequence[str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Cast the label columns to categorical with a fixed, explicit order.

    The order of ``categories`` is the order of rows/columns in the z-score
    matrix, so fixing it makes the heatmap identical across runs.
    """
    for key in [cluster_key] + ([library_key] if library_key else []):
        if key not in adata.obs:
            raise KeyError(
                f"obs['{key}'] 不存在。现有列: {list(adata.obs.columns)}"
            )
        values = adata.obs[key].astype(str)
        if key == cluster_key and cluster_order is not None:
            missing = sorted(set(values) - set(cluster_order))
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"obs['{key}'] 里有未登记的标签: {missing}")
            adata.obs[key] = pd.Categorical(
                values, categories=list(cluster_order), ordered=True
            )
        else:
            adata.obs[key] = pd.Categorical(values)


def assert_spatial(adata: ad.AnnData, spatial_key: str = "spatial") -> None:
    if spatial_key not in adata.obsm:
        raise KeyError(
            f"obsm['{spatial_key}'] 不存在；本函数要求输入已带空间坐标的 h5ad"
        )
    coords = np.asarray(adata.obsm[spatial_key])
    if coords.ndim != 2 or coords.shape[1] < 2:
        raise ValueError(f"obsm['{spatial_key}'] 形状异常: {coords.shape}")
    if not np.isfinite(coords[:, :2]).all():
        raise ValueError(f"obsm['{spatial_key}'] 含 NaN/Inf")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# graph
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_graph(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    library_key: str | None = None,
    coord_type: str = "grid",
    n_neighs: int = 6,
    n_rings: int = 1,
    delaunay: bool = False,
    radius: float | None = None,
    spatial_key: str = "spatial",
) -> ad.AnnData:
    """Build the spatial adjacency graph, per library when ``library_key`` is set.

    ``coord_type='grid'`` + ``n_neighs=6`` + ``n_rings=1`` is the Visium hex
    lattice (each spot has 6 hex neighbours). Use ``coord_type='generic'`` for
    kNN / Delaunay on imaging platforms (Xenium, CosMx, MERFISH).
    """
    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {
        "spatial_key": spatial_key,
        "coord_type": coord_type,
        "delaunay": delaunay,
    }
    if library_key is not None:
        kwargs["library_key"] = library_key
    if coord_type == "grid":
        kwargs["n_neighs"] = n_neighs
        kwargs["n_rings"] = n_rings
    elif radius is not None:
        kwargs["radius"] = radius
    else:
        kwargs["n_neighs"] = n_neighs

    sq.gr.spatial_neighbors(adata, **kwargs)
    return adata


def cross_library_edges(adata: ad.AnnData, library_key: str) -> int:
    """Count adjacency edges whose two endpoints come from different libraries.

    Zero is the only acceptable value for a per-section graph. A positive
    number means the graph merged sections and every downstream z-score is
    contaminated by "neighbours" that are physically on another slide.
    """
    conn = adata.obsp["spatial_connectivities"].tocoo()
    lib = adata.obs[library_key].astype(str).to_numpy()
    return int(np.sum(lib[conn.row] != lib[conn.col]))


def graph_summary(adata: ad.AnnData, library_key: str | None) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Graph diagnostics; ``isolated_spots`` and ``median_degree`` catch a broken grid."""
    conn = adata.obsp["spatial_connectivities"]
    n_nodes = conn.shape[0]
    n_edges = int(conn.nnz)
    degree = np.asarray((conn > 0).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    stats: dict[str, object] = {
        "n_spots": n_nodes,
        "n_edges": n_edges,
        "mean_degree": round(n_edges / n_nodes, 3) if n_nodes else np.nan,
        "median_degree": float(np.median(degree)) if n_nodes else np.nan,
        "min_degree": int(degree.min()) if n_nodes else 0,
        "isolated_spots": int(np.sum(degree == 0)),
        "n_libraries": int(adata.obs[library_key].nunique()) if library_key else 1,
        "cross_library_edges": cross_library_edges(adata, library_key) if library_key else 0,
    }
    return stats


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# enrichment
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def enrich(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    cluster_key: str,
    library_key: str | None = None,
    n_perms: int = 1000,
    seed: int = 0,
    n_jobs: int = 1,
    show_progress_bar: bool = False,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, list[str]]:
    """Run the permutation test; return (zscore, count, labels) in label order.

    ``library_key`` must match the key used for the graph: with it, the null
    distribution is generated by permuting labels *within* each section, which
    is the correct null for "do these two niches touch more often than chance
    inside one tissue section".
    """
    zscore, count = sq.gr.nhood_enrichment(
        adata,
        cluster_key=cluster_key,
        library_key=library_key,
        n_perms=n_perms,
        seed=seed,
        n_jobs=n_jobs,
        show_progress_bar=show_progress_bar,
        copy=True,
    )
    labels = list(adata.obs[cluster_key].cat.categories)
    return np.asarray(zscore, dtype=float), np.asarray(count, dtype=float), labels


def write_matrix(matrix: np.ndarray, labels: Sequence[str], path: Path) -> None:
    """Write one square matrix as a tidy, Excel-friendly TSV."""
    frame = pd.DataFrame(matrix, index=list(labels), columns=list(labels))
    frame.index.name = "niche_row"
    frame.columns.name = "niche_col"
    frame.to_csv(path, sep="\t", float_format="%.4f")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# plotting
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def symmetric_limit(matrix: np.ndarray, step: float = 5.0,
                    exclude_diagonal: bool = True) -> float:
    """Round the colour limit up to a multiple of ``step`` so 0 stays white.

    ``exclude_diagonal`` defaults to True: with crisp domains the diagonal
    z-scores are an order of magnitude above the off-diagonal ones, and a
    scale that fits the diagonal paints every interesting pair white. The
    diagonal then saturates at the colour limit — the printed numbers still
    give its true value.
    """
    values = np.array(matrix, dtype=float)
    if exclude_diagonal and values.ndim == 2 and values.shape[0] == values.shape[1]:
        values = values[~np.eye(values.shape[0], dtype=bool)]
    finite = values[np.isfinite(values)]
    if finite.size == 0:
        return step
    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(finite)))
    return max(step, float(np.ceil(peak / step) * step))


def plot_heatmap(
    matrix: np.ndarray,
    labels: Sequence[str],
    ax: plt.Axes | None = None,
    title: str = "",
    cbar_label: str = "Spatial proximity (z-score)",
    cmap: str = "RdBu_r",
    annotate: bool = True,
    limit: float | None = None,
    fontsize: float = 8,
    exclude_diagonal: bool = True,
    show_cbar: bool = True,
) -> plt.Axes:
    """Red = more adjacent than chance, blue = less, white = as expected."""
    if ax is None:
        _, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.2, 4.6))
    limit = (symmetric_limit(matrix, exclude_diagonal=exclude_diagonal)
             if limit is None else limit)
    image = ax.imshow(
        matrix, cmap=cmap, interpolation="nearest", vmin=-limit, vmax=limit
    )
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels)), labels, rotation=90, fontsize=fontsize)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(labels)), labels, fontsize=fontsize)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=fontsize + 2)
    if annotate:
        for i in range(matrix.shape[0]):
            for j in range(matrix.shape[1]):
                value = matrix[i, j]
                if not np.isfinite(value):
                    continue
                ax.text(
                    j, i, f"{value:.1f}",
                    ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize - 1,
                    color="white" if abs(value) > 0.5 * limit else "black",
                )
    if show_cbar:
        colorbar = ax.figure.colorbar(image, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.03)
        colorbar.set_label(cbar_label, fontsize=max(fontsize - 1, 6), labelpad=2,
                           rotation=90, va="bottom")
        colorbar.ax.yaxis.set_label_position("right")
        colorbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=max(fontsize - 2, 6), pad=2)
    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    return ax


def plot_domains(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    cluster_key: str,
    library_key: str | None = None,
    spatial_key: str = "spatial",
    title: str = "Spatial domains",
    point_size: float = 6.0,
    palette: str = "tab10",
) -> plt.Figure:
    """Small-multiple spot map, one panel per library."""
    coords = np.asarray(adata.obsm[spatial_key])[:, :2]
    labels = list(adata.obs[cluster_key].cat.categories)
    colors = plt.get_cmap(palette).colors
    color_map = {lab: colors[i % len(colors)] for i, lab in enumerate(labels)}

    if library_key is None:
        groups = [("all", np.arange(adata.n_obs))]
    else:
        groups = [
            (str(lib), np.where(adata.obs[library_key].astype(str).to_numpy() == str(lib))[0])
            for lib in adata.obs[library_key].cat.categories
        ]

    n_panels = len(groups)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, n_panels,
        figsize=(4.2 * n_panels, 4.2),
        squeeze=False,
    )
    lab_values = adata.obs[cluster_key].astype(str).to_numpy()
    for ax, (name, idx) in zip(axes[0], groups):
        xy = coords[idx]
        # Invert y so the section is drawn as it sits on the slide.
        ax.scatter(
            xy[:, 0], -xy[:, 1],
            s=point_size,
            c=[color_map[v] for v in lab_values[idx]],
            linewidths=0,
        )
        ax.set_title(f"{name}\n(n={len(idx)} spots)", fontsize=9)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])
        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)

    handles = [
        plt.Line2D([], [], marker="o", linestyle="", markersize=6,
                   markerfacecolor=color_map[lab], markeredgecolor="none", label=lab)
        for lab in labels
    ]
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles, loc="lower center", ncol=min(len(labels), 5),
        frameon=False, fontsize=8, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02),
    )
    fig.suptitle(title, fontsize=11)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 0.95))
    return fig


def save_pdf(fig: plt.Figure, path: Path, dpi: int = 300) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fig.savefig(path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# comparison
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compare_matrices(
    reference: np.ndarray, other: np.ndarray, labels: Sequence[str]
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Quantify how far a "wrong" matrix drifts from the per-library one."""
    diff = other - reference
    off = ~np.eye(len(labels), dtype=bool)
    finite = np.isfinite(reference) & np.isfinite(other)
    return {
        "max_abs_diff": float(np.nanmax(np.abs(diff))),
        "mean_abs_diff": float(np.nanmean(np.abs(diff))),
        "max_abs_diff_offdiag": float(np.nanmax(np.abs(diff[off & finite]))),
        "pearson_r": float(np.corrcoef(reference[finite], other[finite])[0, 1]),
        "n_sign_flips": int(np.sum(np.sign(reference[off & finite]) != np.sign(other[off & finite]))),
        "n_pairs_offdiag": int(np.sum(off & finite)),
    }


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z一-龥]+", "_", str(text)).strip("_")
    return text or "label"
